hints: Focus on atom conservation, since X plus water must supply all the H, Cl and O found in the two acid products.
Count atoms in 1 HCl plus 5 HClO3 to find you need 6 Cl, 6 H and 15 O atoms in total on the product side.
Try fitting each possible X to give 6 Cl atoms, then see which one plus a whole number of water molecules gives exactly 6 H and 15 O.
walkthrough:
**Count what the products need**

Think of the reaction as X + water making 1 mole of HCl and 5 moles of HClO3. Let us add up all the atoms on the product side.

$$1 \times \text{HCl} + 5 \times \text{HClO}_3 \rightarrow \text{H}_6\text{Cl}_6\text{O}_{15}$$

**Work out what water provides**

All the hydrogen must come from water, because X contains no H. To get 6 H atoms we need 3 water molecules.

$$3\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{H}_6\text{O}_3$$

**Find what X must supply**

Subtract the water contribution from the total needed. X must supply 6 Cl atoms and the remaining oxygen.

$$\text{O needed from X} = 15 - 3 = 12, \text{ so X unit} = \text{Cl}_6\text{O}_{12}$$

**Match to the options**

Divide Cl6O12 into a simple formula. Cl6O12 is the same as 6 units of $\text{ClO}_2$.

$$6\text{ClO}_2 + 3\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{HCl} + 5\text{HClO}_3$$

**Conclude the identity**

The equation balances perfectly for atoms, so X could be $\text{ClO}_2$. This is a disproportionation where chlorine (oxidation state +4) forms -1 in HCl and +5 in HClO3.

options.A: Cl2 has no oxygen, so with water it could only give O atoms from water. Water cannot supply 15 O atoms while supplying only 6 H atoms, so the 1:5 ratio is impossible.
options.B: Cl2O is too oxygen-poor. To get 6 Cl you would need 3 Cl2O, giving only 3 O from X plus 3 O from 3 H2O, which is 6 O total, far short of the 15 O needed.
options.C: Correct and balanced. 6 ClO2 provides Cl6O12, and 3 H2O provides H6O3, giving H6Cl6O15 in total, exactly 1 HCl + 5 HClO3. All atoms balance.
options.D: Cl2O7 is too oxygen-rich. To get 6 Cl you would need 3 Cl2O7, giving 21 O from X alone, already more than the 15 O needed in the products, so it cannot fit.
